tool_description:
Read the current cloud environment configuration and credential readiness.

Read this task's managed cloud environment configuration and observed readiness. Returns network policy, configured capabilities, safe failure guidance, secret variable/file bindings and outbound identity aliases, without credential values. A null VPN failure does not establish VPN readiness. For restricted networking, allowed_hosts lists custom domains and presets lists selected groups. When resolved, preset_allowed_hosts lists preset domains and effective_allowed_hosts lists the complete policy. These resolved lists describe the desired spec; state reports whether it is enforced. Takes no arguments; the runtime supplies the instance. Unknown or stale observations do not establish credential readiness.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__cloud_environment_environment_status(args: {}): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
